verses.text: For the choirmaster. According to Jeduthun. A Psalm of David. In God alone my soul finds rest; my salvation comes from Him.

xrefs.text: The LORD is good to those who wait for Him, to the soul who seeks Him.
He alone is my rock and my salvation. He is my fortress; I will never be shaken.
But those who wait upon the LORD will renew their strength; they will mount up with wings like eagles; they will run and not grow weary, they will walk and not faint.
Be still before the LORD and wait patiently for Him; do not fret when men prosper in their ways, when they carry out wicked schemes.
Our soul waits for the LORD; He is our help and our shield.

verses.text: He alone is my rock and my salvation. He is my fortress; I will never be shaken.

xrefs.text: The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer. My God is my rock, in whom I take refuge, my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold.
We are hard pressed on all sides, but not crushed; perplexed, but not in despair;
He alone is my rock and my salvation; He is my fortress; I will not be shaken.
Trust in the LORD forever, because GOD the LORD is the Rock eternal.
Each will be like a shelter from the wind, a refuge from the storm, like streams of water in a dry land, like the shadow of a great rock in an arid land.

verses.text: How long will you threaten a man? Will all of you throw him down like a leaning wall or a tottering fence?

xrefs.text: Wash the evil from your heart, O Jerusalem, so that you may be saved. How long will you harbor wicked thoughts within you?
who devise evil in their hearts and stir up war all day long.
“How long will you judge unjustly and show partiality to the wicked? Selah
Those who seek my life lay snares; those who wish me harm speak destruction, plotting deceit all day long.
this iniquity of yours is like a breach about to fail, a bulge in a high wall, whose collapse will come suddenly— in an instant!

verses.text: They fully intend to cast him down from his lofty perch; they delight in lies; with their mouths they bless, but inwardly they curse. Selah

xrefs.text: His speech is smooth as butter, but war is in his heart. His words are softer than oil, yet they are swords unsheathed.
Do not drag me away with the wicked, and with the workers of iniquity, who speak peace to their neighbors while malice is in their hearts.
For not a word they speak can be trusted; destruction lies within them. Their throats are open graves; their tongues practice deceit.
For in my inner being I delight in God’s law.
Although they know God’s righteous decree that those who do such things are worthy of death, they not only continue to do these things, but also approve of those who practice them.

verses.text: Rest in God alone, O my soul, for my hope comes from Him.

xrefs.text: But as for me, I will look to the LORD; I will wait for the God of my salvation. My God will hear me.
Still I am certain to see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.
“The LORD is my portion,” says my soul, “therefore I will hope in Him.”
Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why the unease within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise Him, my Savior and my God.
For You are my hope, O Lord GOD, my confidence from my youth.

verses.text: He alone is my rock and my salvation; He is my fortress; I will not be shaken.

xrefs.text: Surely he will never be shaken; the righteous man will be remembered forever.
He alone is my rock and my salvation. He is my fortress; I will never be shaken.
I have set the LORD always before me. Because He is at my right hand, I will not be shaken.
The righteous will never be shaken, but the wicked will not inhabit the land.
For who is God besides the LORD? And who is the Rock except our God?

verses.text: My salvation and my honor rest on God, my strong rock; my refuge is in God.

xrefs.text: But You, O LORD, are a shield around me, my glory, and the One who lifts my head.
Trust in the LORD forever, because GOD the LORD is the Rock eternal.
But the LORD has been my stronghold, and my God is my rock of refuge.
The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer. My God is my rock, in whom I take refuge, my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold.
Surely deception comes from the hills, and commotion from the mountains. Surely the salvation of Israel is in the LORD our God.

verses.text: Trust in Him at all times, O people; pour out your hearts before Him. God is our refuge. Selah

xrefs.text: Be anxious for nothing, but in everything, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present your requests to God.
Trust in the LORD forever, because GOD the LORD is the Rock eternal.

Arise, cry out in the night from the first watch of the night. Pour out your heart like water in the presence of the Lord. Lift up your hands to Him for the lives of your children who are fainting from hunger on the corner of every street.
I pour out my complaint before Him; I reveal my trouble to Him.
“No, my lord,” Hannah replied. “I am a woman troubled in spirit. I have not had any wine or strong drink, but I have poured out my soul before the LORD.

verses.text: Lowborn men are but a vapor; the exalted are but a lie. Weighed on the scale, they go up; together they are but a vapor.

xrefs.text: You, indeed, have made my days as handbreadths, and my lifetime as nothing before You. Truly each man at his best exists as but a breath. Selah
All the nations are as nothing before Him; He regards them as nothingness and emptiness.
Surely the nations are like a drop in a bucket; they are considered a speck of dust on the scales; He lifts up the islands like fine dust.
It is better to take refuge in the LORD than to trust in princes.
You discipline and correct a man for his iniquity, consuming like a moth what he holds dear; surely each man is but a vapor. Selah

verses.text: Place no trust in extortion or false hope in stolen goods. If your riches increase, do not set your heart upon them.

xrefs.text: Instruct those who are rich in the present age not to be conceited and not to put their hope in the uncertainty of wealth, but in God, who richly provides all things for us to enjoy.
“Look at the man who did not make God his refuge, but trusted in the abundance of his wealth and strengthened himself by destruction.”
Like a partridge hatching eggs it did not lay is the man who makes a fortune unjustly. In the middle of his days his riches will desert him, and in the end he will be the fool.”
If I have put my trust in gold or called pure gold my security,
And when the LORD your God brings you into the land He swore to your fathers, to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, that He would give you— a land with great and splendid cities that you did not build,

verses.text: God has spoken once; I have heard this twice: that power belongs to God,

xrefs.text: After this I heard a sound like the roar of a great multitude in heaven, shouting: “Hallelujah! Salvation and glory and power belong to our God!
For God speaks in one way and in another, yet no one notices.
Trust in the LORD forever, because GOD the LORD is the Rock eternal.
I have spoken once, but I have no answer— twice, but I have nothing to add.”
Ascribe the power to God, whose majesty is over Israel, whose strength is in the skies.

verses.text: and loving devotion to You, O Lord. For You will repay each man according to his deeds.

xrefs.text: For the Son of Man will come in His Father’s glory with His angels, and then He will repay each one according to what he has done.
For according to a man’s deeds He repays him; according to a man’s ways He brings consequences.
For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ, that each one may receive his due for the things done in the body, whether good or bad.
Then the LORD passed in front of Moses and called out: “The LORD, the LORD God, is compassionate and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion and faithfulness,
God “will repay each one according to his deeds.”
